_meta.acs: ACS 2020–2024 5-year (B25031, B25064, B25077, B25103), www2.census.gov table-based summary files
_meta.bea: BEA Regional Price Parities 2024 (SARPP state, MARPP metro), apps.bea.gov
_meta.rentNote: ACS median GROSS rent (contract rent + utilities) of existing leases; asking rents on new leases run higher. The engine converts gross to contract rent.
_meta.propTaxNote: Median real estate taxes paid ÷ median home value (ACS), so a blended effective rate.
_meta.stateTax: PLACEHOLDER — effective state income tax % of gross, not yet sourced. Replace with Tax Foundation / state schedules.

fields.rent: median gross rent by bedroom count (0 = studio … 4 = 4BR), USD/month
fields.rentMedian: median gross rent, all units, USD/month
fields.medianHome: median value of owner-occupied homes, USD
fields.propTaxPct: effective property tax, % of value per year
fields.rpp: metro BEA RPP for the principal city’s metro area (null when not matched → state RPP is used)
fields.stateTaxPct: effective state income tax, % of gross (placeholder)
